
  enqueue <queue> <payload>
    Enqueue a task

    The payload may be a literal string, `@path` to read a file, or `-` to read
    stdin. Per-call flags override the queue's defaults.

  USAGE
    enqueue [flags] <queue> <payload|@file|->

  FLAGS
    --lease         <duration>   Lease length for this task only
    --max-attempts  <uint32>     Attempt budget for this task only
    --scheduled-at  <timestamp>  Delay the first delivery until this RFC3339 time
    --key           <string>     Subject key this task belongs to

  EXAMPLES
    > mikyu enqueue jobs "send email"
    > mikyu enqueue jobs @job.json --scheduled-at 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z
